queries: housing market days on market trend

findings.claim: Nationally homes are listed roughly 78 days before an accepted offer, against a five year average near 51 days.
findings.sourceTitle: Housing Inventory: Median Days on Market, FRED

findings.claim: Inventory has risen substantially year over year in several major metros, giving buyers more options and more negotiating room than a year ago.
With more inventory, agents report that pricing, condition, presentation and marketing matter more than they did in a tighter market.
findings.sourceTitle: August 2026 Real Estate Market Update, Buyers and Sellers

findings.claim: Buyers have more time and less competition than a year ago, so a listing that does not stand out sits rather than selling below asking.
